# `aitbc grant list`

List DAO grant proposals with optional status, developer, and pagination filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc grant list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status |
| `--developer-id` | text | — | no | Filter by developer ID |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Maximum number of grants |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc grant list
```
